original_text: Plant Hormones Gibberellinsare growth-promoting hormones Gibberellins cause stem elongation; ~70 types nEach differ slightly chemically nMost common -gibberellic acid Can be used commercially to grow larger crops, and can be used to break dormancy in plants
explanation: Gibberellins are growth-promoting hormones that primarily stimulate stem elongation. There are approximately 70 chemically distinct types of gibberellins, with gibberellic acid being the most common. In agriculture, gibberellins are used commercially to increase the size of crops and fruits. They are also applied to seeds to break dormancy and initiate germination.

questions.q: What is the primary growth effect of gibberellins?
opts: Inducing fruit drop and leaf abscission
questions.exp: The primary physiological effect of gibberellins is to stimulate stem elongation.

questions.q: Which of the following is a commercial application of gibberellins?
opts: Breaking seed dormancy and growing larger crops
Inhibiting the growth of weeds with toxic compounds
questions.exp: Gibberellins are used commercially to break seed dormancy (promoting germination) and to increase crop size.
